stories.headline: Netflix to Report Box Office Numbers for 6 Upcoming Movies as Streamer Escalates Theatrical Plans (EXCLUSIVE) - Variety
stories.summary: How serious is Netflix going to get about releasing its movies in theaters?
stories.why: Netflix's willingness to compete theatrically signals the streaming wars are entering a new phase where prestige and box office legitimacy matter—if your favorite films start hitting IMAX instead of your couch, the way you consume entertainment is fundamentally changing.

stories.headline: ‘Practical Magic 2’ Rotten Tomatoes Reviews Splatter Bullock And Kidman Sequel - forbes.com
stories.why: A beloved '90s nostalgia film (Practical Magic) getting demolished by critics suggests the remake-everything strategy is finally hitting a ceiling, which matters if you're tired of seeing your childhood IP recycled into mediocrity.

stories.headline: Lori Loughlin, husband Mossimo Giannulli to divorce after 30 years - USA Today
stories.summary: Lori Loughlin officially filed for divorce from Mossimo Giannulli after nearly 30 years of marriage.
stories.why: A 30-year marriage dissolving after a college admissions scandal and prison time shows how one mistake can unravel an entire family legacy—a cautionary tale about the real consequences of taking shortcuts, regardless of wealth or status.

stories.headline: ‘South Park’ Changes Name to ‘South America’ as Creators Roast Apple and Google for Obeying Trump’s Lake America Name Change - Variety
stories.summary: "South Park" is no more. Long live "South America."
stories.why: South Park's pivot to satirize corporate obedience to political power (Big Tech bowing to a Trump directive) demonstrates how the show remains culturally relevant by mocking the moment we're living through, not just making dick jokes.

stories.headline: ‘Star Wars’ Heads to Imax 70mm for First Time With ‘Starfighter’ and ‘A New Hope’ 50th Anniversary Re-Release - Variety
stories.summary: 'Star Wars' heads to Imax 70mm for the first time with 'Starfighter' and the 'A New Hope' anniversary re-release.
stories.why: Star Wars returning to IMAX 70mm is a rare opportunity to experience a film that defined your childhood the way it was meant to be seen—a reminder that some franchises still respect the theatrical experience over streaming convenience.

stories.headline: Pamela Anderson was given 10 years to live after viral infection: ‘It’s a death sentence’ - PennLive.com
stories.why: A celebrity discovering a life-altering diagnosis publicly forces a reckoning with mortality and resilience that resonates beyond tabloid gossip—it's a reality check about health's fragility regardless of fame or resources.

stories.headline: Ashley St. Clair and Alex Gibney on AI and the dangers of Elon Musk - AP News
stories.summary: A new documentary about Elon Musk uses a CGI avatar and artificial intelligence voice syncing to simulate an interview with the SpaceX and Tesla CEO using things he’s really said in interviews. Filmm…
stories.why: Using AI to simulate interviewing Elon Musk without his participation raises uncomfortable questions about authenticity and consent in media—if filmmakers can deepfake celebrities into narratives they didn't authorize, what does truth in documentary even mean anymore?
